description: The West Lake 4 Drawer Dresser offers an ideal balance of storage and footprint for smaller nurseries. Four dovetailed drawers with full-extension glides provide organized space for clothing and essentials, all within a solid hardwood frame finished in warm Brown Maple. The flat top accommodates a changing pad, creating a convenient diaper station. Coordinates with the full West Lake collection. Non-toxic, baby-safe finishes.
